description: This file contains utility functions for database operations and HTML encoding/decoding in the SuiteCRM project, including deprecated methods, HTML entity handling, and database name validation.

methods.name: db_convert
methods.description: Deprecated function that converts a string based on database manager's convert method.

methods.name: db_concat
methods.description: Deprecated function that concatenates database table fields.

methods.name: from_db_convert
methods.description: Deprecated function that converts from database format to application format.

methods.name: to_html
methods.description: Replaces specific characters in a string with their HTML entity equivalents.

methods.name: from_html
methods.description: Replaces HTML entity values in a string with their corresponding characters.

methods.name: getValidDBName
methods.description: Generates a valid database column name based on the input string.

methods.name: isValidDBName
methods.description: Checks if a proposed database name is valid for the specified database type.
